headline: The most expensive watches ever sold at auction
stop_reason: HELD (attempt 3): sourcing gap, no build. LISTICLE needs 8-10 ranked items, each with an opened source, hammer price, sale date, auction house and fee status. A search this round surfaced only snippet-level figures for about 5 watches: Only Watch 2019 Grandmaster Chime 6300A-010 (Christie's Geneva, 9 Nov 2019, CHF 31,000,000); Henry Graves Supercomplication (CHF 23,237,000); Paul Newman Daytona 6239 (Phillips New York, 26 Oct 2017, US$17.75m); Gobbi Milano Heures Universelles 2523 (Christie's Hong Kong, 23 Nov 2019, HKD 70,175,000); Patek 1518 (Phillips Geneva, Nov 2016, US$11m). None was opened on the auction house's own results page, and none has a stated fee status. Snippets are not reads, so nothing was posted. Owner decision needed: (1) Accept a shorter 5-item list (under the 8-item minimum) with the auction house results pages as sources, or (2) approve a different angle, such as a 'Top 5 auction records by house' format, that needs fewer confirmed items. Until one is chosen, this candidate stays held.
